approach: Characterization assertions run against actual pre-refactor and refactored source. Network/database adapters are deterministic mocks; no monitoring target or database is contacted.

availability.runtime: ping_behavior and poller_util_behavior retain availability-method combinations. snmp_behavior covers GET/GETNEXT integers, skipped hosts, timeout optional/fatal behavior, sysDesc missing-object exception, recoverable USM drift, multi-GET success/PDU-wide failure/timeout.
availability.source_only: SNMP credential setup, session lifecycle, indexed-PDU repair retries and walk/count internals retain control flow. Net-SNMP owns transport retry and timeout behavior.

runtime.sql_behavior: 1205/1213: 50ms between failures, 31 failures exhaust the shared budget. db_insert returns FALSE; db_query exits 1. 2006/2013 reconnects use the same budget and fatal die after 31 failures. EINTR retries at 50ms do not consume it. Reconnection via changed mysql_ping thread ID retains seven side queries per reconnect.
runtime.script_behavior: Three command write attempts at most; each failed attempt closes/restarts the server. Timeout restarts and returns U; EOF returns U.
runtime.support_behavior: Spawn EAGAIN/ENOMEM allow initial attempt plus retry_limit attempts; other errors return immediately. PID is published only on success.

retries.source_only: db_connect normally has two attempts, increments its attempts counter after failure, and does not consume tries for EINTR on connection errors. Explicit db_connect reconnection and connection-option/SSL negotiation are not exercised against a database.

formatting.runtime: CLI help/version exit codes, stdout and stderr match remaining_cli_baseline.json. Script CRLF and intact newline output, exact 42/U/empty SNMP results and keyword names/fallbacks are asserted.
formatting.source_check: SQL/output/protocol literal sequences are unchanged in all C files except PHP: its same overflow error literal moves before the read, and strstr("\n") becomes equivalent strchr('\n'). This is a literal comparison, not a complete runtime log trace.

database_writes.runtime: SQL dry_run and SQL_readonly bypass mysql_query; normal insertion passes the exact query unchanged; SQL errors/retries/reconnect side-query counts and exhausted pools are asserted. Earlier poller_util_behavior checks generated persistence SQL.
database_writes.source_only: Startup/final settings/date, poller_time and remote push routing retain queries and predicates. Live MariaDB writes, escaping under a connected server character set, SSL, and final main-process persistence are not integration-tested.

script_protocols.runtime: Legacy PHP argv through Cacti 1222; --environ=spine and --poller=N afterward; remote online/offline argv; Started handshake sets READY; round robin wraps; query framing uses CRLF. Long command truncation still loses the CRLF. Production nft_popen launches a fixed child, reads hello\n, returns raw exit status 7, and invalid/stale descriptors return EBADF. Production environment helper filters controlled LD_PRELOAD/DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES/BASH_ENV values and injects PATH/IFS.
script_protocols.source_only: Malformed Started handshake still marks BUSY while php_init returns TRUE. Environment allocation failure still falls back to environ. No PHP interpreter integration is claimed.

shutdown.runtime: PHP close sends quit\r\n, closes descriptors and sets them -1; only PIDs >1 are terminated. nft_pclose closes/waits/removes entries. Fatal signal installation/restoration respects custom handlers. Mutex initialization remains repeatable; all mapped locks acquire/release. Existing circuit breaker tests cover cooldown and shutdown.
shutdown.source_only: SIGTERM stops scheduling and shortens main drain deadline to 30 seconds or remaining poll interval. Pools, PHP, heap, SQL and SNMP teardown order is unchanged. No full polling-daemon shutdown with active database/SNMP workers is simulated.

intentional_safety_changes: PHP retry intermediate U allocations are freed before retry.
INIT command uses a const literal rather than an allocation, including early failure paths.
PHP reads reserve one terminator byte; an unterminated response filling RESULTS_BUFFER-1 returns U and stops reading. Maximum valid newline-terminated content is RESULTS_BUFFER-1 bytes.
Payload validation copies into an aligned struct; valid wire data at any byte alignment produces the same result.

platform_evidence.macOS: Production executable build, strict C17 syntax checks and runtime platform tests.
platform_evidence.Windows: Source review only; allocation sizes and zero aggregate initialization refactored without changing argv quoting, job flags, transport/error mappings or handle operations. Windows branches are excluded by the macOS preprocessor.
platform_evidence.Linux_BSD: Source review only for Linux confinement and BSD-specific branches. No sandbox rules, syscall allowlists, privilege transitions, OS retry policies or no-op fallback behavior changed.

already_idiomatic: Files listed in scope without production changes were reviewed and kept as existing typed wrappers or bounded optional-feature implementations.
limitations: Not every branch has a characterization test. Mocks verify application contracts, not database, Net-SNMP transport or PHP interoperability.
Existing async-signal-unsafe fatal logging and other unrelated legacy semantics are preserved, not certified safe.
No Annex K or new optional bounds-checking library was introduced.

validation.literal_comparison: SQL/output/protocol literals preserved; equivalent PHP newline character search and moved overflow diagnostic documented above
validation.cli_golden_test: Exit/stdout/stderr captured; test normalizes only release version for future version bumps
